verdict.rationale: Conductor's docs say each workspace has its own diff and review path, and that it helps you review the diff before opening a PR and merging. Failing-check logs and PR comments load in the app, and agents can run tests and builds in the workspace terminal/environment. This covers inspecting diffs and catching problems before merge. Missing for 10: in-depth documentation of the diff viewer and review workflow, explicit docs on running checks yourself before merge (beyond agents running tests and viewing CI failure logs), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
